games.name: Aeronautica
games.desc:
Train, Buy, Fly - Aeronautica is an open-world flight simulator with economy elements where the goal is entirely up to you. Earn money by completing unique jobs or flights between distant islands and continents. You can even create an airline for you and your friends to join! 

Train and earn licenses to unlock exciting new vehicles. Customize and maintain your vehicles as you work your way up from the smallest ultralights to the world’s largest airliners like the Airbus A380 Superjumbo. 

In Aeronautica you can explore:

> ✈️ 800+ unique vehicles in 10 different classes to unlock. Ranging from airliners to ultralights, and fighter jets to boats 
> 🛫 210+ airports and heliports, ranging from dirt runways to large international airports 
> 💸 Custom player-run airlines for you and your friends 
> 📈 Fluctuating player-driven markets where you can sell your acquired aircraft and parts 
> 🎨 Customizable liveries and vehicles
> ⛈️ Dynamic weather

games.name: Rusty Plane
games.desc:
Rusty Plane is a chaotic, co-op survival game where everything will go wrong, and that’s the fun of it. You and up to 5 other players must keep a falling-apart plane in the sky by fixing holes, repairing lights and pipes, regaining control, refueling, and re-oxygenating the cabin, all while chaos unfolds around you. Choose from 19 unique classes, each with their own special abilities, and see how long you can survive the madness.

Inspired by My Rusty Submarine
Game is currently in a Public-Beta stage, meaning the game isn't fully finished, so expect small bugs.
This game gets updated almost everyday and bugs are always fixed within a short amount of time. You can report bugs/players or give suggestions using the games feedback system.
If this game causes the end of your friendship, it is not my fault, remember, it's just a game.
